conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: My card payment’s stuck on ‘processing’ for two days! What’s the deal?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the delay Sir. Can you share the transaction ID or card number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Card ends in six seven eight nine. I don’t get why it’s taking so long!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It seems the payment gateway had a glitch. I’ll manually process it now.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Man, this is annoying. Just get it done!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s processed Sir. The payment’s complete, and you’ll see it in your statement.
